description:
Could today's Middle East be following the same path that led Europe into World War I?

In this in-depth analysis, we examine five major developments that have dramatically reshaped the Middle East—from escalating U.S.-Iran tensions and renewed fighting involving the Houthis, to Russia's reported deployment of a high-level command aircraft to Tehran. More importantly, we explore why historians and geopolitical analysts are drawing comparisons to the chain reaction that triggered World War I in 1914.

Is the world really on the brink of a larger conflict, or are we witnessing another dangerous period of escalating regional crises?

In this episode, we break down the historical parallels, strategic calculations, and geopolitical risks behind one of the most volatile moments in recent years.

If you enjoy thoughtful geopolitical analysis and long-form storytelling, don't forget to subscribe and turn on notifications for future episodes.
